mentions.name: Easylang browser IDE
mentions.description: A browser-based IDE for the Easylang programming language. Its smart tab completion parses the entire program up to the cursor on every tab press, letting users avoid a lot of typing and potential errors — for example, typing a few characters and pressing tab quickly produces a circle drawn on screen.
mentions.problem: Avoids a bunch of typing and potential errors while writing code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on the browser editor for my programming language, With the smart tab completion - which parses the entire program up to the cursor every time you press tab - you can avoid a bunch of typing and also potential errors.
